header-navigation.observed: Hamburger 'Menu button' opens an off-canvas drawer showing 5 top-level categories (Health, Wellness, Beauty, Community Stories, Buying Guides). Clicking a top-level item drills down to reveal its child categories inline with a 'Back' button to return to the top level. 'Close button' dismisses the drawer. 110 nav items across 2 levels (level-0, level-1).

search.observed: Header search icon toggles a search field (role=search, name=fulltext). Predictive search: min 3 chars (data-cmp-min-length=3), 10 results (data-cmp-results-size=10). AJAX GET to /content/content-hub/us/en/homepage.searchresults.json/_jcr_content/root/customheader/search?fulltext=<q>. Verified endpoint returns JSON array of {title, description, url, lastModified}. Loading indicator + Clear button present.

hero-carousel.observed: Homepage hero auto-advances between 5 slides (the 'Viewing' dot indicator moved from slide 0 to 3 to 4 without interaction). Dot navigation links (#carousel-0..4). Custom JS (no jQuery/slick on this component). Each slide = image + headline + CTA link.

category-hub.observed: Featured hero cards at top; 'The latest' horizontal carousel with disabled/enabled Previous/Next buttons + 'see all' link; main article grid; client-side pagination (numbered page buttons, prev/next enable-disable at bounds, 'Jump to page' spinbutton). Clicking page 2 swapped grid content in place WITHOUT URL change or reload; prev enabled, next disabled, spinbutton synced to 2. Promo blocks (2 image tiles). 'Explore more' subcategory tiles with live 'N New articles' counts.

article.observed: Breadcrumb, category eyebrow, H1, date + read-time meta, rich-text body with headings/lists/images, red separators. 'Explore more' related-article cards (medium variation) at foot.

jump-to-section.observed: On recipe/step articles, a 'Jump to section' dropdown button expands a list of anchor links pointing to in-page section IDs (#Ingredients, #step1..#step5). Toggles open/closed.

video-article-youtube.observed: Article whose lead media is a YouTube iframe embed (play button, channel link). Includes optional 'Featured products' block linking out to walgreens.com store PDPs, and a 'Transcript' section. Explore-more cards show video duration badges + play-icon overlays.

video-episode-theater.observed: Podcast/video episode pages embed either Scene7 VideoViewer (s7d6.scene7.com/s7viewers) or a Spotify podcast iframe. 'More episodes' opens an episode carousel (S1:E1..E10 thumbnails with season/episode badges) with Previous/Next slide buttons. 'Read transcript' link points to a paired transcript page.

video-transcript.observed: Plain rich-text transcript page paired 1:1 with a video-episode page (linked via 'Read transcript'). No media player.

scroll-to-top.observed: Floating scroll-to-top button present on article/category pages (cmp-scroll-to-top-button).

footer.observed: Mega-footer: Walgreens logo (home link), social links (Pinterest, Facebook, Twitter/X, Instagram), 'Visit Walgreens.com', full category link columns (Health, Wellness, Beauty, Community Stories), legal links (Online Privacy & Security, Your Privacy Choices -> walgreens.com donotsell), medical disclaimer, copyright. Delivered as an Experience Fragment (cmp-experiencefragment--footer).
